title: Waiting Credit Schedule for Severe Dispensing Errors, Tailwise Pharmacy
content:
*Customer care service-recovery schedule, pharmacy.*

A severe claim on a Tailwise Pharmacy fill — wrong medication or wrong strength recorded on the claimed fill, the most recent dispensed fill of the prescription — also earns a waiting credit, added to the dispensing-error refund. The credit follows how long the customer has been left with the erroneous fill, counted in calendar days from the claimed fill's dispense date to the refund date.

## Schedule

| Claim | Calendar days from the claimed fill's dispense date to the refund date | Waiting credit |
|---|---|---|
| Severe | 10 or more | $4.00 |
| Severe | at least 5 but fewer than 10 | $2.00 |
| Severe | fewer than 5 | nothing |
| Wrong quantity or wrong label | any | nothing |

## Boundary days (hypothetical dates, fill dispensed 2026-06-01)

| Refund date | Days counted | Waiting credit on a severe claim |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-11 | 10 | $4.00 |
| 2026-06-10 | 9 | $2.00 |
| 2026-06-06 | 5 | $2.00 |
| 2026-06-05 | 4 | nothing |

The count runs from the dispense date to the refund date in calendar days: a refund dated 10 days after the dispense date is at 10 days.
